app.checklistOfferHelp: You approve it on the setup page.

app.badgeAttention: OSI Time Tracker: setup needs attention
app.currentWebsiteHelp: You approve it on the setup page, and its trackers separately.
app.checklistActionHelp: You approve it on the setup page.

approvals.websitesHelp: OSI websites that may use the extension.
approvals.websitesEmptyHelp: The OSI website that should use the extension.
approvals.websiteHelp: The address you open OSI at. Approving it asks the browser for access to this website.
approvals.websiteHttpHelp: http:// works only for local addresses (localhost, 127.0.0.1).
approvals.websiteHandoff: This address comes from the tab where you opened the extension. Approve it if it is the OSI website you use.
approvals.revokeWebsiteConfirmBody: This removes the approval of this website and of {count} trackers:
approvals.revokeWebsiteConfirmSafe: Nothing changes in the trackers themselves.
approvals.destinationsHelp: Last activity covers the current browser session.
approvals.destinationsEmptyHelp: Each tracker is approved separately for an OSI website.
approvals.destinationHelp: The tracker's base address, with its installation path if it has one.
approvals.httpWarning: Whenever OSI connects to this tracker, its API key travels unencrypted, so others on the network can read it.
approvals.websiteApproved: Website approved. Reload its open tabs.
approvals.repaired: Setup refreshed. Reload your OSI tabs to reconnect.
approvals.denied: Permission was denied, so nothing was saved. Approve again to retry.
approvals.loadFailed: The extension could not read its approved websites and trackers. Nothing was deleted. If this keeps happening, restart the browser.
approvals.changeFailed: The change could not be fully completed. The list shows the latest saved approvals. Try again to finish cleaning up permissions.
approvals.setupFailed: Approvals are saved, but your OSI websites could not be connected to the extension. Try again, then reload your OSI tabs.
approvals.lost_tracker_popup: The browser took the extension's access to this tracker away.
approvals.lost_tracker_setup: The browser took the extension's access away. The approval is still saved.
approvals.lost_website_popup: The browser took the extension's access to this OSI website away.
approvals.lost_website_setup: The browser took the extension's access away. The approval is still saved.
approvals.lostAccessMany_popup: The browser took the extension's access away from: {names}.
approvals.lostAccessMany_setup: The browser took the extension's access away from: {names}. Restore it in their rows.
approvals.websitePermissionMissing: This tracker's website has no access. Restore it under Approved websites.
approvals.invalidWebsiteFormat: Enter the full address with https://, e.g. https://time.example.com.
approvals.invalidWebsiteHttp: Use an https:// address; http:// works only for localhost and 127.0.0.1.
approvals.invalidWebsitePath: Enter just the website address, without a path or parameters, e.g. https://time.example.com.
approvals.invalidWebsiteCredentials: Remove the user name and password from the address.
approvals.invalidDestination: Enter an address starting with https:// (or http://), without credentials, parameters or a fragment.
approvals.suggestionsHelp: Your OSI website asks for access to these trackers. Approve only the ones you know.
approvals.revokeWebsiteConfirmBodyOne: This removes the approval of this website and of 1 tracker:

error.extensionIncompatible: This website needs a newer OSI extension.
error.extensionPermissionRequired: The extension needs permission for this website or tracker.
error.extensionUnknownCreate: The time entry may already exist on the tracker. Check before retrying.
